messages:
laura: quick FYI — EU egress tightening deployed 03:12UTC and we just started seeing nodes in eu-west-1 fail during GPU pool join. AccessDenied on ENI attach.
sam: saw that too. a few warm nodes stuck in Attaching state, then error. no autoscaler pop.
tess: security rolled the egress + iam tweak last night. i thought the rollout was limited to controlplane roles, but maybe the node role was included.
laura: logs show this:
```
ERROR 2024-03-19T03:18:02Z attach-eni: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/gpu-node-role/i-0abcd is not authorized to perform: ec2:AttachNetworkInterface on resource: eni-0f1e2d3c4b5a
```
nick: that looks like iam:PassRole / attach permissions. our node bootstrap uses an assume-role + passrole to attach ENIs for enhanced networking.
maria: confirmed. policy for `gpu-node-role` lost `ec2:AttachNetworkInterface` during the rotation. security-bot, did the role change include a deny?
security-bot: automated change: rotated IAM boundary policy and applied egress firewall rule 172.31.0.0/16 deny across eu accounts. No explicit deny on ec2:* in boundary, but `PassRole` scoping tightened for `role/*-priv`.
sam: can we hotfix by adding `ec2:AttachNetworkInterface` back to the node role or relax the passrole scoping? which is faster?
tess: fastest is to restore the previous policy for gpu-node-role in eu account. i'll push a scoped fix and notify.
ops-bot: action logged: create change request CHG-8421 — revert-gpu-node-iam-eu
laura: also, the egress firewall is causing probes to fail to reach our keystore in privnet which delays bootstrap. two-pronged: iam + egress. preferring iam revert first.
nick: +1. if we revert IAM, nodes should attach ENIs and at least join even with longer keystore latency.
security-bot: note: full revert requires approval from security on-call. if revert is time-sensitive, we can apply a temporary exception for `gpu-node-role`.
maria: i've opened a temp exception: `egress-exception-gpu-nodes` for eu-west-1 03:30-04:30UTC. combined with iam revert should be good.
tess: applied policy revert to `gpu-node-role` in eu account, pushed `iam-change-375123` now. rolling restart of warm pool incoming.
ops-bot: deploy: rolling restart started for eu warm-pool (batch size 10). monitor: https://internal/ops/dashboards/warm-pool-eu
sam: warm nodes are now attaching and joining. CPU/GPU quotas look ok. one node still failing keystore handshake, probably keystore grant scope — will follow.
laura: create a short runbook PR to prevent this: 1) IAM rotate checklist verify node role attachments 2) egress rollout dry-run with warm-pool canary 3) add detection alert for ENI Attach failures.
nick: I'll draft the runbook and link to CHG-8421 and the temp exception.
laura: thanks all, keep the thread updated with any lingering failures. we'll do a postmortem if churn > 10% of warm pool.
